{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Restrict to the treatment arm only, as per the causal estimand of treatment response
# The 'arm' column has values 'treatment' and 'control'
treatment_df = df[df['arm'] == 'treatment']

# Verify that both sexes are present in the treatment arm
treatment_sex_counts = treatment_df['sex'].value_counts()

# Compute response rates within the treatment arm only
response_rates_treatment = treatment_df.groupby('sex')['responded'].mean() * 100  # Convert to percentage

# Compute the difference in response rates (female - male)
difference_treatment = response_rates_treatment['F'] - response_rates_treatment['M']

# Print results
print("Treatment arm only:")
print("Sex distribution:", treatment_sex_counts)
print("Response rates by sex (treatment arm only):", response_rates_treatment)
print("Difference (F - M):", difference_treatment)"}
